caption: This exploded view of a Rane Madras mechanical steering assembly illustrates the internal components of the steering box, including the rocker shaft, column, and ball race mechanisms. It is essential for diagnosing steering play, binding, or oil leaks, and provides the necessary sequence for disassembling the steering box and adjusting the rocker shaft end play.
fault_relevance: Excessive steering play due to worn ball race or rocker shaft
Oil leakage from steering box via oil seal
Binding steering due to worn bushings or lack of lubrication
repair_relevance: Adjusting steering play via adjusting screw
assembly_order: Install ball race and column assembly
Install drop arm and lock nut

caption: This wiring diagram illustrates the Air Filter Clog indicator circuit for the machine. It shows the electrical path from the battery through the ignition switch and air filter clog switch to the instrument cluster, which activates the warning light. A technician can use this to troubleshoot a non-functional or constantly illuminated air filter warning light.
fault_relevance: Air filter warning light not turning on
Air filter warning light staying on constantly
Blown fuse in the air filter circuit
repair_relevance: Troubleshooting electrical faults in the air filter monitoring system
Testing continuity of the air filter clog switch
Verifying power supply to the instrument cluster

caption: This wiring diagram illustrates the coolant temperature indication circuit, showing the path from the battery through the ignition switch and a 5A fuse to the instrument cluster. It includes the temperature sensor input and the output indicators (LED/bulb and gauge) on the instrument cluster. Technicians can use this to troubleshoot open circuits, blown fuses, or faulty sensor readings.
fault_relevance: Open circuit in temperature sensor wiring
Blown 5A fuse causing loss of temperature indication
repair_relevance: Verifying power supply to instrument cluster

caption: This wiring diagram illustrates the oil pressure monitoring system, showing the path from the battery through the ignition switch and instrument cluster to the oil pressure switch. It helps technicians trace electrical continuity for oil pressure warning light issues. The system includes a 40A main fuse and a 5A instrument cluster fuse.
fault_relevance: Oil pressure warning light not illuminating
Oil pressure warning light staying on constantly
Open circuit in oil pressure switch wiring
repair_relevance: Testing continuity of oil pressure sensor circuit
Verifying power supply to instrument cluster

caption: This is a basic power circuit diagram for the machine's electrical system. It illustrates the path from the battery through a 40A fuse, the ignition switch, a 15A fuse, and a power connection located at the RH fender, returning to the battery ground. Technicians can use this to trace power loss or short circuit issues within the main electrical supply line.
fault_relevance: Ground fault at RH fender connection

caption: This is a wiring diagram for the fuel level indicator system. It shows the electrical path from the battery through the ignition switch and fuses to the instrument cluster and fuel level sensor. Technicians can use this to troubleshoot fuel gauge inaccuracies or complete power loss to the instrument cluster.
fault_relevance: Open circuit in fuel sender wiring
repair_relevance: Verifying power supply to instrument cluster

caption: This wiring diagram illustrates the electrical circuit for the RPM meter and hour counter system. It shows the connection path from the battery through a 40A fuse to the instrument cluster, which drives the hour meter and RPM meter, and its connection to the alternator via a 5A fuse. Technicians can use this to troubleshoot power supply issues to the instrument cluster or signal failures from the alternator.
repair_relevance: Troubleshooting electrical power to instrument cluster
Diagnosing RPM signal issues from alternator

caption: This wiring diagram illustrates the starter circuit for the machine, including the battery, starter relay, transmission neutral safety switch, and instrument cluster. It is essential for diagnosing starting issues, such as a failure to crank, by tracing power flow from the battery through the fuses and safety interlocks to the starter solenoid.

This is a simplified electrical circuit diagram for the horn system. It illustrates the power path from the battery through a 40A fuse, the ignition switch, a 10A fuse, and the combination switch to the horn. Technicians can use this to troubleshoot horn failure by checking for voltage at each connection point.
fault_relevance: Open circuit in ignition or combination switch
Loss of ground connection at horn
repair_relevance: Testing continuity of ignition and combination switches

caption: This is a wiring diagram for the head lamp system, detailing the battery, fuse block, light switch terminal positions, and relay-controlled high/low beam circuits. It allows a technician to trace power flow from the battery through the 40A main fuse to the light switch and individual 15A beam fuses to troubleshoot lighting failures.

This wiring diagram illustrates the electrical circuit for the park and brake lights, including the battery, starter switch, combination switch, and instrument cluster. It allows a technician to trace power flow through the 40A, 10A, and 5A fuses to identify open circuits, blown fuses, or faulty switches. The diagram is essential for troubleshooting lighting failures or instrument cluster illumination issues.

It details the alignment of the main support housing, the lower mounting plate, and the hardware required for securing the axle assembly. Technicians should use this to verify the correct orientation of the support bracket and the placement of fasteners during reassembly.

caption: This exploded view illustrates the assembly sequence of a tractor steering knuckle, wheel hub, and spindle assembly. It details the arrangement of bearings, seals, and the hub mounting hardware, which is critical for diagnosing wheel play, bearing failure, or steering linkage issues.
assembly_order: press inner bearing and seal onto spindle
tighten castle nut to specified torque

caption: This exploded view illustrates the hydraulic pump assembly and its associated fluid lines. It details the connection points for the pump, the mounting flange, the drive gear, and the routing of the hydraulic supply and return lines. Technicians can use this to identify seal locations, fitting orientations, and the sequence for mounting the pump to the housing.
fault_relevance: hydraulic fluid leaks at elbow fittings
loose mounting hardware causing pump vibration
assembly_order: install drive gear onto pump shaft
connect hydraulic lines with elbow fittings

caption: This exploded view shows the crankcase assembly for the 245DI engine, detailing the installation of cylinder liners, main bearing shells, and main bearing caps. It illustrates the critical alignment of bearing inserts and the securing hardware for the crankshaft support structure. Technicians should use this to verify the correct orientation of thrust washers and bearing halves during engine overhaul.
fault_relevance: Cylinder liner cavitation or seal failure
Loss of oil pressure due to bearing clearance issues
assembly_order: Install main bearing shells into crankcase and caps
Insert cylinder liners with seal rings
Position main bearing caps onto studs

caption: This exploded view of the crankcase assembly details the mounting of the front cover, oil pan, and water pump components. It provides critical guidance for sealing the engine block, replacing the front oil seal, and servicing the water pump drive assembly.
fault_relevance: Oil leaks at the front cover or oil pan gasket
repair_relevance: Front cover removal and gasket replacement
assembly_order: Install oil pan rails and gasket
Mount water pump to front cover
